_comment: Saved X searches for the dashboard's X tab. Each one opens live X results in a new browser tab. The app scrapes nothing. Edit, add or remove searches. The query uses X's own search syntax (OR, quotes, -filter:replies, lang:en). Refresh the dashboard to see changes.

searches.label: Chief of Staff
searches.why: Founders hiring someone to run things alongside them.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "we're hiring" OR "looking for") "chief of staff"

searches.label: Founder's Associate
searches.why: Junior right-hand roles that report straight to a founder.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") ("founder's associate" OR "founders associate" OR "founding associate")

searches.label: BizOps / Strategy & Ops
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") ("bizops" OR "business operations" OR "strategy & operations" OR "strategy and operations")

searches.label: First hire / generalist
searches.why: Early teams looking for a do-everything first non-engineering hire.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") ("first non-technical hire" OR "first ops hire" OR "first business hire" OR "generalist") (startup OR founder)

searches.label: Startup finance
searches.why: Strategic finance and first finance hires at startups.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") ("strategic finance" OR "first finance hire" OR "finance lead" OR "head of finance") startup

searches.label: Startup internships
searches.why: Founders posting ops, strategy, growth or finance internships.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") (intern OR interns OR internship) (startup OR founder) (ops OR operations OR strategy OR growth OR finance)

searches.label: YC startups
searches.why: Y Combinator founders hiring for non-engineering roles.
searches.query: (YC OR "Y Combinator") ("hiring" OR "looking for") (ops OR operations OR generalist OR "chief of staff" OR "founder's associate" OR growth)

searches.label: Toronto startups
searches.why: Toronto founders hiring for ops and strategy.
searches.query: Toronto ("hiring" OR "looking for") (startup OR founder) (ops OR operations OR generalist OR strategy OR "chief of staff" OR growth)

searches.label: AI training work
searches.why: Remote contract work training AI models in finance.
searches.query: ("hiring" OR "looking for") ("AI trainer" OR "AI tutor" OR "finance experts" OR "domain experts") (finance OR banking OR "private equity")
